description: Sends each incoming gate to output A or output B at random, with the odds set by a knob

params.text: The chance used each time a gate arrives, 0 to 1, at 0.5 by default; the MODE setting fixes what that chance applies to
Scales the PROBABILITY CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Steps through three ways of choosing: B PROB gives B the chance and A whatever is left over, ALTERNATE flips B's state when the chance comes up, INDEPENDENT rolls A and B separately
Steps through three output shapes: TRIGGERS gives a 1ms pulse on the chosen output, HOLD keeps it high until the next gate, GATE follows the incoming gate. GATE is the default

inputs.text: A rising edge here re-rolls the choice between A and B
Modulates the probability, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob

outputs.text: 10V whenever A is the chosen side, in the shape set by the OUT button
10V whenever B is the chosen side, in the shape set by the OUT button
